logo.title: Logo
logo.subtitle: Approved lockups and the rules that keep them recognizable.
logo.loadError: We couldn't load the logo files. Please try again.
logo.clearspaceDescription: Keep clearspace of at least 1× the height of the K on every side. Nothing — text, imagery, or edges — enters that space.
logo.minimumSize: Minimum size: 24px height on screen, 10mm in print. The icon mark may go down to 16px.

dos.clearspace: Keep the full clearspace around the lockup.
dos.approvedFiles: Use the vector files from this page — always the latest version.
dos.contrast: Place the logo on surfaces with enough contrast to stay legible.

donts.recolor: Don't recolor the logo or apply gradients to it.
donts.distort: Don't stretch, squash, rotate, or skew the lockup.
donts.effects: Don't add shadows, outlines, or other effects.
donts.rebuild: Don't retype or redraw the wordmark — download it.

logo.allFilesDescription: Every K Lab and product logo in the catalog, including vector masters for print.

colors.title: Colors
colors.subtitle: The palette as design tokens — swatches show the live value in your current theme.
colors.copyFailed: We couldn't copy that. Try selecting the value instead.
colors.tokenNote: Product colours are CSS custom properties, so components adapt automatically when a token is retuned — reference the token name in code rather than a hard-coded hex. The accent-brand token matches the K Lab identity blues from @k-lab/components (navy in light, electric blue in dark).

typography.title: Typography
typography.subtitle: One typeface, a fixed scale, and the tokens that ship with it.
typography.typefaceDescription: Sora carries every K Lab surface — product UI, decks, and marketing. Weights 300 to 700; headings sit at 600–700, body at 400.
typography.specimenText: Finance that moves at the speed of your business
typography.scaleDescription: Size, weight, and line height for each step. Download the tokens below to use them in code.
typography.downloadsDescription: Everything you need to reproduce K Lab typography in a new surface.

imagery.title: Imagery
imagery.subtitle: Approved backgrounds and textures, and how to apply them.

dos.approvedSets: Use the approved sets below for decks, covers, and hero sections.
dos.contrast: Keep text over imagery legible — add an overlay if contrast drops.
dos.crop: Crop to the focal area rather than scaling the whole image down.

donts.stretch: Don't stretch images to fit a frame.
donts.recolor: Don't recolor or heavily filter brand imagery.
donts.clutter: Don't stack multiple busy images in one layout.
